sn22.49:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn22.49:1.3: atha kho soṇo gahapatiputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn22.49:1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho soṇaṃ gahapatiputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn22.49:2.1: ye hi keci soṇa, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aniccena rūpena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena seyyohamasmīti vā samanupassanti,
sn22.49:2.5: aniccāya vedanāya dukkhāya vipariṇāmadhammāya seyyohamasmīti vā samanupassanti,
sn22.49:2.14: aniccena viññāṇena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena seyyo’hamasmīti vā samanupassanti,
sn22.49:3.1: ye ca kho keci soṇa, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aniccena rūpena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena seyyo’hamasmīti’pi na samanupassanti,
sn22.49:3.8: aniccena viññāṇena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena seyyo’hamasmīti’pi na samanupassanti,
sn22.49:4.4: yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā’ti?
sn22.49:4.6: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.49:4.7: etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā’ti?
sn22.49:4.11: yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attāti? no hetaṃ bhante. saññā …pe…
sn22.49:4.15: yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn22.49:4.17: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ,
sn22.49:4.18: etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attāti?
sn22.49:5.1: tasmātiha soṇa, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā, oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā, hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.49:6.4: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā, oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā, hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.49:7.1: evaṃ passaṃ soṇa, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmi’mpi nibbindati, vedanāya’pi nibbindati, saññāya’pi nibbindati, saṅkhāresu’pi nibbindati viññāṇasmi’mpi nibbindati.
sn22.49:7.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.49:7.3: “khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti pajānātīti.
